releaseNotes: The tutorial now lets you tap the highlighted tab to open each page yourself, instead of switching screens without warning.
The app slides to the next page and scrolls smoothly to the feature before highlighting it.
Instructions use shorter, clearer wording about the buttons and what they do, including turning dinner and lunch days on or off.
The white bottom navigation, active-tab indication, tap-outside-to-advance, Skip and replay from Settings are retained.
Existing meals, preferences, favourites, cupboard items and shopping checks are preserved.
